tasks.short: Review the research literature for this problem.

steps.what: Search the research literature for the question.

loop.output: Search list with a link or citation for each paper
loop.check: Analyst drops an item with no citation
loop.stop: One pass; stop after the analyst's set limit; no citation means no item
loop.why_not_simpler: Relevance is not a keyword match

steps.what: Read the papers and judge which findings apply.
Note the findings that bear on this problem.

loop.output: Literature note with a citation on every finding
loop.check: Analyst removes a finding with no citation
loop.stop: One draft; no citation means the sentence is deleted
loop.why_not_simpler: A finding is a claim from a paper, not a template

tasks.design: A search list keeps only items with a citation. Reading and judging what applies stays with the analyst. The note in {DOCS} may state a finding only when the reading notes cite it. There is no agent that answers the research question.
tasks.previous_blocker: Searches and notes were a pile of files, and a finding could lose its paper.
tasks.enabler_now: A citation can be required on every line. Judging that a paper applies cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A paper that is on the question and still the wrong setting.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows which result will not survive contact with this operation.
tasks.altitude: Search filing shrinks. Reading stays. The analyst can reject a note that has a finding without a paper.

reach.task: Keep a citation next to a claim taken from a paper
reach.learn: How they stop a sentence that no longer has a source

evidence.claim: A literature note can require a citation. Deciding that a paper applies stays with the reader.
The best agent in a benchmark solved 21.3 percent of enterprise text-to-SQL tasks.

assumptions: Focal role is the operations research analyst. Boundary: from a question to a literature note. A systematic review for publication is out of scope.
Structured fields are citation, finding and applies or not. The analyst sets applies. Fallback: no citation, no line.
Test a {DOCS} note before custom code. Do not add an agent that reads the corpus and answers the question.
Upkeep of 2.5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the note template. The text-to-SQL benchmark is a warning about unattended answers, not a literature result.
unknowns: Which libraries or indexes this team can actually open.
Whether notes are shared outside the team.
research_questions: What share of questions repeat papers the team has already read?
How often is a finding dropped because the setting does not match?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the question is new and reading is most of the hour. High case: the search list is tighter and the note is quicker, while reading stays. An unattended answer is not used.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reading stays the week. Search lists and citation checks take less time. The analyst can delete a finding that has no paper.
reach: Health informatics specialists keep a citation on every claim they reuse
skills_to_grow: Requiring a citation before a finding is filed
Saying when a paper's setting does not match
role.ambitious_version: The analyst spends reading time on papers that might apply, with every filed finding still tied to a citation.
